description: This Perl module defines the class Git::SVN::Fetcher, which is a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor. It implements callbacks used during 'git svn fetch' to process Subversion repository deltas, capturing changes, properties, file modifications, directory states, and handling special cases such as empty directories and placeholders. It interacts heavily with git and Subversion commands and internal data structures to store and manage the state required for efficient repository synchronization.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor that collects changes from Subversion deltas during 'git svn fetch', storing information about file modifications, directory states, properties, and handling special cases such as empty directories and placeholders for later processing.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Fetcher object, sets up configuration options, creates internal data structures, and loads prior placeholder information.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the root directory.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Returns a hash representing an opened directory at the specified path.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Removes an entry at the specified path, deleting associated files or directories, and updates internal state.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Returns a hash with information about a file at the specified path, including its mode and blob ID.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Marks a file to be added to the repository, setting its mode and associated metadata.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Marks a directory to be added, handling empty directories and placeholder files for empty directories.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records a change in a directory's property.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records a directory that cannot be conveyed (e.g., permission issues).

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records a file that cannot be conveyed.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Records a change in a file property, including handling executable bits and special flags.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares for applying text deltas to a file, setting up temporary storage and verifying content hashes.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes a file's delta application, computes the new object hash, and updates internal storage.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Completes the edit, manages empty directories and placeholders, and finalizes the internal state.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Identifies directories that are empty after deletions and changes and may require placeholders.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Adds a placeholder file in an empty directory to preserve its existence.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Saves the list of added placeholders to the repository configuration for future use.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a path is inside a .git directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be ignored based on ignore/include regexes and repository rules.
